description: Source code for Azure Foundry (Azure AI) Agent Service handler, implementing multi-step agent flow including thread creation, message handling, run creation, polling, and streaming responses with support for both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: AzureAIAgentsHandler
classes.description: Handler class for managing Azure AI Agent Service interactions, including thread management, message exchange, run execution, polling, and streaming responses.

methods.name: _build_thread_url
methods.description: Constructs URL for creating or accessing threads.

methods.name: _build_messages_url
methods.description: Constructs URL for message operations within a thread.

methods.name: _build_runs_url
methods.description: Constructs URL for creating or accessing runs within a thread.

methods.name: _build_run_status_url
methods.description: Constructs URL for polling run status.

methods.name: _build_list_messages_url
methods.description: Constructs URL for listing messages in a thread.

methods.name: _build_create_thread_and_run_url
methods.description: Constructs URL for creating thread and run with streaming support.

methods.name: _extract_content_from_messages
methods.description: Extracts assistant's reply content from message data.

methods.name: _build_model_response
methods.description: Builds a ModelResponse object from agent output, including token usage estimation.

methods.name: _prepare_completion_params
methods.description: Prepares headers and URL parameters for API requests, including Bearer token authentication.

methods.name: _check_response
methods.description: Validates HTTP response status codes and raises errors if unexpected.

methods.name: completion
methods.description: Performs synchronous agent completion, managing thread, messages, run, and response retrieval.

methods.name: _execute_agent_flow_sync
methods.description: Executes the full agent flow synchronously: thread creation, message addition, run creation, polling, and message retrieval.

methods.name: acompletion
methods.description: Performs asynchronous agent completion with full flow management.

methods.name: _execute_agent_flow_async
methods.description: Executes the full agent flow asynchronously: thread creation, message addition, run creation, polling, and message retrieval.

methods.name: acompletion_stream
methods.description: Performs asynchronous streaming completion using native SSE, processing SSE events and yielding chunks.

methods.name: _process_sse_stream
methods.description: Processes SSE stream, extracting message deltas and thread creation events, yielding streaming chunks.
